theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_si_ae_forall_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (F : ℝ → Set (Euclid P) → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → (∀ t, Monotone (F t)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ t, F t K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → F t K ≠ ∞
